name: experiment-rewrite-workflows
description: Loopback Codex workflow for rewriting paper experiment baselines into a unified PyTorch framework with parameter validation, contract locking, minimal validation, profiling, and CSV reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite experiment baselines through a staged Codex workflow.
interface.longDescription: Installs repo-local Codex custom agent templates for an iterative experiment rewrite workflow with Stage 0 parameter validation, experiment contract locking, baseline triage, input adapter planning, controlled PyTorch rewrite, minimal validation, profiling, CSV output, and reviewer-driven loopback.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite my paper experiment baselines after collecting requirements.
Validate experiment rewrite parameters before touching code.
Lock my repo dataset, shape, metric, and launch contract.
Triage baseline folders and plan PyTorch rewrites.
Run minimal validation and profile rewritten models.
Generate the final model completion CSV.
